data.revised_prompt:
Create a single 1536x1152 PNG sprite sheet for a 2D game attack FX animation. Canvas exactly 1536x1152, divided invisibly into 3 rows x 4 columns of equal 384x384 frame slots. Background must be pure solid flat chroma-key magenta #FF00FF everywhere between and around frames. NO visible grid lines, no frame borders, no labels, no text, no numbers, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Each effect centered in its cell with generous magenta padding, nothing touching cell edges, consistent visual center and scale.

Subject: FX-only attack effect, no full character body. Style: clean HD pixel-inspired RPG battle sprite FX, crisp readable silhouettes, transparent-ready edges, saturated aquatic palette. Visual identity palette: royal blue dragon energy, cyan fin/horn-like glow, white-hot highlights, gold-and-white regal armor language, jewel-like accents, sharp polished aquatic fantasy sprite style. Card motif inspiration only: oceanic card-back shapes and poker-card silhouettes, but no readable ranks, no letters, no numbers, no suit symbols, no full card faces.

Animation title: Royal Card Judgment. 12 frames read left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Compact overlay FX suitable for a fixed-size avatar cell. Use abstract dragonfire, royal sigils, horn-crown light, card-shaped shards, spark trails, impact energy. Regal, precise, dangerous, aquatic. No black background, no smoke cloud covering cell, no wide fullscreen blast. Particles tightly grouped and fully inside cell.

Frame details:
1: small cyan horn-crown glint at center with faint thin gold royal ring, quiet start.
2: blue motes gather inward, thin gold crescent sigil begins forming.
3: three or four abstract blank card-shaped light shards spiral into the sigil, ocean-blue backs, no markings.
4: dragonfire coil forms compact S-shaped curl with white-hot core and cyan edges.
5: stronger charge, gold royal circle and cyan flame petals tighten, jewel glints.
6: release begins, diagonal blue-white judgment slash appears from lower-left to upper-right, cards pulled behind it, compact.
7: peak impact, brightest frame, compact dragonfire burst, gold sigil flare, pearl sparks, still inside cell.
8: shockwave ring expands slightly but remains inside cell, card shards scatter outward, no edge touching.
9: dragonfire curls back into smaller spiral, white core fading to cyan.
10: gold sigil breaks into clean fragments, tiny blue sparks drift near center.
11: residual cyan horn-crown glow and two faint blank card-shaped afterimages.
12: loop-ready settle, almost empty, faint cyan royal spark and small gold dust.

Pixel-inspired with clean anti-aliased edges, polished sprite sheet asset, consistent bounding box and center across all 12 frames.
